aspects.description: Application runs against the provided swaploop_admin MySQL seed
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Import assets/db/swaploop_admin.sql into MySQL database swaploop_admin and start the app. Seeded staff accounts (e.g. admin@swaploop.test / password123) can be used for sign-in.

aspects.description: Server-side project structure and maintainability
judgementScoreDescription: Code is unstructured; unclear separation of routes, views, and data access
Basic folder structure exists but naming and layering are inconsistent
Clear SSR project layout with sensible separation of routes/controllers, views, and data access
Excellent modular structure, consistent patterns, and easy-to-follow server-rendered architecture

aspects.description: Staff can sign in with email and password using a server-side session
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Sign in as admin@swaploop.test with password123. Authentication verifies the seeded bcrypt password_hash in staff_users (no other hashing algorithm) and subsequent requests stay authenticated via cookie/session.

aspects.description: Invalid credentials show a clear error message
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Submit a wrong password for a known email. A clear error is shown and no session is created.

aspects.description: Suspended accounts cannot sign in
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Sign in as suspended.admin@swaploop.test with password123. Sign-in fails and no authenticated session is created.

aspects.description: Suspended sign-in shows a distinct suspended message
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Attempt suspended.admin@swaploop.test / password123. The message is distinct from a generic invalid-credentials error.

aspects.description: Signed-in users can sign out
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Sign in, then sign out. The session ends and protected pages require login again.

subCriterions.name: Application shell, navigation, and access control

aspects.description: Shell shows SwapLoop Admin, current user name and role, and a sign-out control
aspects.extraDescription: Test: After login, the signed-in chrome shows product name SwapLoop Admin, the current user's name and role, and a working sign-out control.

aspects.description: Successful sign-in redirects the user to the Dashboard page
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Submit valid credentials from the sign-in page. Authentication succeeds and the user is redirected to the role-appropriate Dashboard page.

aspects.description: Navigation is limited to what the signed-in role may use
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Compare nav for PLATFORM_ADMIN, FLEET_MANAGER, STATION_ADMIN, and ACCOUNTANT against the Allowed areas table. Only permitted destinations appear.

aspects.description: Dashboard summarises counts relevant to the signed-in role
aspects.extraDescription: Test: PLATFORM_ADMIN sees network-wide counts; FLEET_MANAGER own partner; STATION_ADMIN assigned stations/units; ACCOUNTANT a finance entry point.

aspects.description: Unauthenticated visitors only reach the login experience
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Open a protected URL while signed out. The app shows login and does not render protected admin content.

aspects.description: Role scopes are enforced server-side on lists and mutations
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As FLEET_MANAGER, STATION_ADMIN, and ACCOUNTANT, attempt out-of-scope list/create/edit URLs or form posts. Actions fail even if UI controls are bypassed; ACCOUNTANT finance is read-only.

aspects.description: Cross-scope requests show access-denied and hide foreign data
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Open another partner's or station's resource as a scoped role. Access-denied wireframe appears and lists never include foreign rows.

aspects.description: PLATFORM_ADMIN can create and edit staff accounts with password rules
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Create a staff user with a password — the stored password_hash is bcrypt. Edit the same user leaving password blank — existing hash remains and the account still signs in with the old password.

aspects.description: Staff role, partner, and station assignment rules are enforced
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Assign exactly one of the four roles. Fleet managers require a partner; other roles must not carry one. Station admins require at least one station assignment; other roles must not carry station assignments.

aspects.description: A platform admin cannot suspend their own account
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Sign in as a PLATFORM_ADMIN and attempt to suspend the same account. The update is rejected and the account remains active.

aspects.description: Station lifecycle transitions are enforced
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Exercise PLANNED→ACTIVE/DECOMMISSIONED, ACTIVE→SUSPENDED/DECOMMISSIONED, and SUSPENDED→ACTIVE/DECOMMISSIONED. DECOMMISSIONED accepts no further changes. New stations start only as PLANNED or ACTIVE.

aspects.description: Station suspension reasons follow the status rules
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Set a station to SUSPENDED without a reason and confirm the update is rejected. Set a reason and confirm it succeeds. Change to a non-suspended status and confirm no suspension reason is retained.

aspects.description: Only PLATFORM_ADMIN may create stations; STATION_ADMIN is limited to assigned stations
aspects.extraDescription: Test: STATION_ADMIN cannot create stations and can only list/edit assigned stations. PLATFORM_ADMIN can create and manage any station.

aspects.description: Unit type fields follow compatibility rules
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Create or edit a SWAP_BAY and confirm battery_type is required while connector_type is rejected. For a BIKE_BAY, confirm connector_type is required while battery_type is rejected.

aspects.description: Unit labels are unique within each station
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Create two units with the same label in one station and confirm the duplicate is rejected. Confirm the same label can be used at a different station.

aspects.description: Station type limits which unit types it may contain
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Confirm SWAP stations accept only SWAP_BAY units, CHARGING stations accept only BIKE_BAY units, and HYBRID stations accept both types.

aspects.description: Blocked units require a reason
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Set a unit to BLOCKED without a reason and confirm the update is rejected. Provide a reason and confirm the update succeeds.

aspects.description: PLATFORM_ADMIN can manage partners with a subscription plan from the database
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Create/edit a partner (name, status, contact, fleet size) and assign a subscription plan loaded from the seed — not hard-coded plan ids in source.

aspects.description: Drivers are scoped by role with unique employee code and email
aspects.extraDescription: Test: PLATFORM_ADMIN manages all drivers; FLEET_MANAGER only own partner. Employee code unique per partner; email unique; status active/suspended.

aspects.description: Billing summary aggregates usage_events for the selected Asia/Shanghai calendar month
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Open billing for a seeded partner and a month that has usage_events. Completed-use count matches events whose completed_at falls in that Asia/Shanghai calendar month. PLATFORM_ADMIN any partner; FLEET_MANAGER own only.

aspects.description: Billing applies plan base fee, quota, overage, and volume discount from the database
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Fees, quota, overage rate, and matching discount tier come from subscription_plans / discount_tiers. Discount reduces overage only; base fee stays undiscounted. Amounts are whole CNY yuan.

aspects.description: Billing breakdown shows partner, period, plan, uses, quota, overage, fees, discount, and total
aspects.extraDescription: Test: On the billing summary screen, all listed fields are visible and match the calculated values for the selected partner and month.

aspects.description: Finance report table has one row per partner plus a network total matching billing rules
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As ACCOUNTANT or PLATFORM_ADMIN, open finance for a month. Each partner row matches that partner's billing summary fields; a network total is shown.

aspects.description: Finance report includes a vertical bar chart without an external chart library
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Chart shows each partner's total for the month. Implementation uses SVG/canvas or equivalent without a third-party chart library.

aspects.description: Finance CSV export is UTF-8 with header row, deterministic columns, and period in the filename
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Export CSV for a selected month. File is UTF-8, includes a header row, column order is stable, and the filename identifies the billing period.

aspects.description: Index lists support filtering, page size 10, and distinct empty states
aspects.extraDescription: Test: On staff, stations, units, partners, and drivers indexes: filters work; pagination uses page size 10; empty-in-scope differs from no-filter-matches.

aspects.description: Invalid form submissions show field-level errors from server-side validation
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Submit an invalid create/edit form (e.g. missing required field). Server-side validation returns the form with field-level errors.

aspects.description: Form controls have labels; status and errors are understandable without colour alone
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Forms expose associated labels. Status values and validation errors include text (or equivalent non-colour cue), not colour alone.

aspects.description: Form focus order follows the provided wireframes
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Use only Tab and Shift+Tab on the primary create and edit forms. Focus moves through controls in the same logical order as their placement in the corresponding wireframes, without skipping or trapping interactive elements.

aspects.description: Screen layouts match the provided wireframes
judgementScoreDescription: Layouts ignore wireframes; major screens missing or unrelated
Some screens loosely follow wireframes but field placement and structure often diverge
Primary screens follow wireframe structure and field placement with minor gaps
Layouts consistently match wireframes across shell, lists, forms, billing, and finance

aspects.description: Overall visual design quality and usability of the admin console
judgementScoreDescription: Poor visual hierarchy; workflows are hard to follow
Basic usable UI with uneven spacing, typography, or navigation clarity
Clear hierarchy and usable primary workflows across roles
Polished, consistent admin UX with strong hierarchy and efficient role workflows
